link.title: Pair the {name}
link.description:
Select **Submit**, then accept Home Assistant's access request on the Freebox display (right arrow).

Then, in Freebox OS (Freebox settings › Access management › Applications), grant the app the **Freebox settings modification** permission for reboot and Wi-Fi, and **Calls manager access** for the call log.
